question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Sustained**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sustained **means to support or uphold something, or to endure or persist through a difficult situation. (किसी चीज़ का समर्थन या समर्थन करना, या किसी कठिन परिस्थिति में सहना या बने रहना)
 
• The sentence suggests that something was supported or upheld, likely behind a curtain.
 
• This word is the most appropriate choice based on the context of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Curtained **means to cover or conceal with a curtain. (पर्दे से ढकना या छिपाना)
 
• **Abstained **means to refrain from doing something, particularly from indulging in a certain behaviour or activity. (कुछ करने से बचना, विशेषकर किसी निश्चित व्यवहार या गतिविधि में शामिल होने से)
 
• **Stained **means to mark or discolour something, often with a substance that is difficult to remove. (किसी चीज़ पर निशान लगाना या उसका रंग फीका करना, अक्सर किसी ऐसे पदार्थ से जिसे हटाना मुश्किल होता है)
